title: Doorbell Nitwit
description: A special nitwit villager who has a chance to show up at your door at night.
body:
**Spawn chance is based on difficulty:**
Peaceful: 0%
Easy: 5%
Normal: 10%
Hard: 20%

**He will spawn if these conditions are met:**
- there must be a bell
- there must be a bed within 14 blocks of that bell
- there must be a door within 12 blocks of that bell
- that valid bell setup must be found within 24 blocks horizontally and 6 blocks vertically of the player


  
**config options** can be put in **config/doorbellnitwit.properties**


**Options:**

spawnChance.easy=0.05

spawnChance.normal=0.10

spawnChance.hard=0.20

vandalismChance=0.50

spawnRadius.min=8

spawnRadius.max=14



**testing commands:**


/doorbellnitwit reload

/doorbellnitwit purge

/doorbellnitwit spawn
